messages.text:
Morning, all. I'd like to hold our CSE455 staff meeting next week. My week is packed, so the only openings I have are short ones:

- Mon Nov 23, 14:00-14:30
- Wed Nov 25, 13:00-13:30

Both are half-hour slots. Can you each tell me which of those works, and whether anyone has a preference to make it a full hour (I'd have to move something of mine to do that)? Also flag anything of yours next week I should know about for the course.

Morning. Both slots work for me — I have nothing at Mon 14:00-14:30 or Wed 13:00-13:30.

On the full hour: I can't do a full hour in either slot without moving something of my own. Mon 14:00-15:00 runs into my research group meeting at 14:30, and Wed 13:00-14:00 runs into my study group at 13:30.
